prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of Labour Party Manifesto 2024 (policy-focused)

Core missions and early actions
- Five missions: highest sustained G7 growth; clean power by 2030; halve serious violent crime and raise confidence in policing; break barriers to opportunity; build an NHS fit for the future.
- First steps: fiscal rules; 40,000 extra weekly NHS appointments; Border Security Command; Great British Energy; antisocial behaviour measures; recruit 6,500 teachers.

Fiscal and tax
- Fiscal rules: current budget to balance; debt falling by year 5; OBR oversight for all fiscal events.
- No increases to National Insurance, Income Tax rates or VAT; maintain BoE independence.
- Tax reforms: abolish non-dom status; end use of offshore trusts to avoid IHT; close private equity carried interest loophole; strengthen HMRC and anti-avoidance.

Security and borders
- NATO and nuclear deterrent maintained; Strategic Defence Review; path to 2.5% of GDP on defence.
- New Border Security Command; more caseworkers; end hotel use; new returns unit; negotiate EU security and returns arrangements; scrap Rwanda scheme.

Economy and business
- Industrial strategy with a statutory Industrial Strategy Council.
- National Wealth Fund (£7.3bn) to crowd-in private investment: ports (£1.8bn), gigafactories (£1.5bn), steel (£2.5bn), carbon capture (£1bn), green hydrogen (£0.5bn).
- Corporation tax capped at 25% for the parliament; permanent full expensing; replace business rates in England.
- Support for SMEs: tackle late payments; British Business Bank reform; procurement access; Post Office and banking hubs.

Infrastructure, transport, digital
- 10-year infrastructure strategy; National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority.
- Planning reform for nationally significant projects; labs, data centres, gigafactories.
- Gigabit broadband and national 5G by 2030.
- Roads maintenance including 1m potholes/year; EV chargepoint rollout and 2030 ICE phase-out restored.
- Rail brought into public ownership as contracts expire; integrated local transport; bus franchising and option for municipal ownership; aviation strategy incl. sustainable fuels.

Housing, devolution, immigration, work and skills
- 1.5m homes: restore housing targets; more planners (funded by higher non-UK buyer surcharge); brownfield first; strategic “grey belt” release; new towns; CPO reform; expand social/affordable housing; mortgage guarantee; first-time buyer priority.
- Devolution in England with Local Growth Plans and multi-year council settlements.
- Reduce net migration; link visa routes to sectoral skills plans; enforce against abuse.
- Jobs and skills: merge Jobcentre Plus and National Careers Service; devolve employment/skills funding; youth guarantee (18–21); Access to Work reform; review/replace Work Capability Assessment.
- Workers’ rights: ban exploitative zero-hours; end fire-and-rehire; day-one rights; Single Enforcement Body; minimum wage to reflect living costs; remove age bands.

Energy, climate, nature, water, farming, animals
- Clean power by 2030: double onshore wind, triple solar, quadruple offshore wind; CCUS, hydrogen, marine; maintain gas reserve; extend existing nuclear, proceed with Hinkley/Sizewell, support SMRs; no new oil and gas exploration licences; ban fracking.
- Great British Energy (£8.3bn) and Local Power Plan; grid upgrades; tighter retail regulation; reduce standing charges.
- British Jobs Bonus (up to £500m/year).
- Warm Homes Plan: £6.6bn to upgrade 5m homes; PRS energy standards by 2030.
- Carbon border adjustment; mandatory 1.5°C-aligned transition plans for major firms/financial institutions.
- Nature recovery, National River Walks, new National Forests; tougher water regulation with fines/bonus bans.
- Public procurement: 50% food local/high-standard; ELM reform; end badger cull; animal welfare bans (trail hunting, trophy imports, puppy smuggling, snares).

Crime and justice
- Neighbourhood Policing Guarantee; efficiency programme; antisocial behaviour “Respect Orders”; specific offence for assaulting shopworkers.
- Knife crime plan: mandatory interventions; bans on certain blades; online sales controls; Young Futures hubs; offence of child criminal exploitation.
- Violence against women and girls: specialist police units; fast-track rape courts; stalking and spiking measures.
- Police standards: mandatory vetting/misconduct rules; fraud strategy; detective direct entry.
- Courts backlog measures; sentencing review; prison building; reoffending reduction; probation governance review; Hillsborough Law; responses to historic inquiries.

Education, childcare, equality, culture
- 3,000 school-based nurseries; review parental leave; unique child identifier.
- Fund schools by ending private school tax breaks; recruit 6,500 teachers; support staff negotiating body.
- Curriculum/assessment review; Ofsted report cards; MAT inspections; SEND inclusion.
- Free primary breakfast clubs; in-school mental health support; Young Futures hubs.
- Post-16: Skills England; devolved adult skills; Technical Excellence Colleges; flexible Growth and Skills Levy; HE funding reform.
- Creative industries plan; arts/technical subject to 16; ticket resale protections; football regulator.
- Equality: socio-economic duty; Race Equality Act; disability and ethnicity pay gap reporting; equal pay extensions; hate crime reform; ban conversion practices; modernise gender recognition while retaining medical diagnosis; uphold single-sex exceptions.

NHS, social care, mental health, public health
- 2m extra annual NHS procedures; shared waiting lists; use independent capacity; workforce plan.
- Double CT/MRI scanners; New Hospitals Programme; NHS innovation/adoption; clinical trials expansion; upgraded NHS app.
- Maternity and patient safety measures; regulate managers; Royal College of Clinical Leadership; implement Cass Review.
- Primary/community care shift: more GPs; face-to-face guarantee; modern booking; pharmacist prescribing; direct referrals; pilot Neighbourhood Health Centres.
- Dentistry Rescue Plan: 700k urgent appointments; contract reform; supervised toothbrushing (ages 3–5).
- National Care Service with national standards; “home first”; Fair Pay Agreement in adult social care; family visiting rights.
- 8,500 extra mental health staff; modernise Mental Health Act.
- Public health: smoke-free generation; youth vaping/junk food/energy drink restrictions; online safety measures; gambling reform; women’s health priority; new HIV action plan.

Governance and foreign policy
- Ethics and Integrity Commission; stronger ministerial standards; ban MPs’ paid consultancies; Commons modernisation.
- Lords reform: remove hereditary peers; retirement at 80; participation requirements; consult on replacement chamber.
- Votes at 16; voter registration improvements; donation rules update.
- Reset intergovernmental relations; Council of the Nations and Regions; devolved frameworks.
- Foreign policy: make Brexit work (technical accords with EU, security pact); ECHR membership; defence industrial strategy; support for Ukraine; AUKUS; China strategy; veterans’ support (incl. visa fee waivers).
- Trade: publish trade strategy; targeted FTAs and sector deals; WTO/CPTPP engagement; OECD minimum tax; partnerships with India, Gulf, Africa.
- Development: rebuild capability in FCDO; restore 0.7% when fiscal conditions allow; ICAI oversight.
